_doc: Purpose: drafting-standard profile for the GB/T (China) system, consumed by cadcore.i18n.standards (projection angle plus sheet/line/lettering/title-block conventions). Background: standard-dependent values must live in data rather than code branches, and any field whose standard text was not obtained stays null and is listed in na_fields, so 'not fetched' can never masquerade as a real value; no standard text is reproduced here (R3).

source.retrieval_method: read-only fetch of public web pages (HTTP status recorded per URL); standard bodies are paywalled and none of their text is copied into this file

projection_angle_evidence.publisher: SAMR national standards full-text system (openstd.samr.gov.cn), official
projection_angle_evidence.shows: GB/T 14692-2008, Chinese title 'Technical drawings - Projection methods', status current, issued 2008-06-26, effective 2009-01-01; this is the GB standard that governs projection methods, so the field is anchored to an official register entry before any value is written.
projection_angle_evidence.grade: official register (metadata only, no clause text read)

projection_angle_evidence.publisher: JLC FA mechanical design handbook (public Chinese engineering handbook)
projection_angle_evidence.shows: States that drawing representation follows GB/T 14692 and that the first-angle method is the preferred one in that system (paraphrase; the clause wording is not copied here).
Journal abstract: China and many other countries mainly use first-angle projection, while some countries mainly use third-angle projection (paraphrase).

source.na_policy: null means not fetched (-1), never 'zero' and never 'not applicable' unless a note says so; every null field is listed in na_fields, and no unverified field is given a guessed value.
notes: na_fields lists exactly the null-valued fields, in contract order: a gate can assert set(na_fields) == {k for k, v in profile.items() if v is None}.

All numeric tables (sheet sizes, line-width series, lettering heights, tolerance grades) live in paywalled GB/T bodies (GB/T 14689, GB/T 17450, GB/T 14691, GB/T 10609.1, GB/T 1800 series) that were not read, so they stay null instead of being filled from memory.

projection_angle is the only field with public evidence for this profile; the evidence grade is recorded per URL so a reviewer can see it is a public-register plus secondary-source chain, not clause-level verification.
